title: BERT masked-language pretraining

paper.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement BERT masked-language pretraining: implement masked-token pretraining and then fine-tune an SST-2 classifier without split leakage. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use sst2-and-pretrain-corpus; required output: Masked tokens -> vocabulary logits; finetuned text -> binary logits. Evaluate accuracy (maximize). Mask labels only; downstream SST-2 test labels excluded from selection. Required ablation: Compare pretrained and randomly initialized encoders at equal finetuning budget. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
